title: Correlative Volume Microscopy of Virus-Containing Amphisomes Using FIB-SEM
author: Lucas, Schmidt, et al.
materials: Focused ion beam scanning electron microscope

steps.title: Produce recombinant KSHV virus
steps.instruction: Generate mScarletH:ORF65.KSHV from BAC16 bacmid iSLK cells grown in DMEM + 10 % FBS with 200 mg/mL hygromycin B, 250 mg/mL geneticin, and 2.5 mg/mL puromycin; induce lytic cycle by removing drugs and adding 1 mg/mL doxycycline and 2.5 mmol/L sodium butyrate; incubate 4 days at 37 °C; harvest supernatant, discard cells, filter through 1.2 µm sterile syringe filter; ultracentrifuge at 30 000 × g, 4 °C for 2 h; resuspend pellet in 50–100 µL DMEM on ice.

steps.title: Determine virus titer and MOI
steps.instruction: Prepare serial dilutions of the virus and infect 50 000 U2OS cells seeded on Ø 12 mm round glass coverslips in a 24‑well plate for 60 min; prepare PBS (2.68 mmol/L KCl, 8 mmol/L Na₂HPO₄, 1.8 mmol/L KH₂PO₄, 136.9 mmol/L NaCl); wash coverslips in PBS, fix in 4 % formaldehyde for 5 min, wash, mount with Dako medium containing 1 mg/mL DAPI; image by confocal microscopy (excitation max 569 nm, emission max 594 nm) and count mScarlet puncta per cell to calculate MOI.

steps.title: Allow virus production period
steps.instruction: The overall virus production and titration workflow takes approximately 5–6 days, including the 4‑day incubation after lytic induction.

steps.title: Culture target GFP‑LC3B cells
steps.instruction: Seed GFP‑LC3B‑transduced U2OS osteosarcoma cells in DMEM + 10 % FBS, 1 % L‑Glutamine, 50 U/mL penicillin‑streptomycin; incubate 24–48 h to allow attachment; maintain at 5 % CO₂, 37 °C.

steps.title: Infect cells with KSHV
steps.instruction: Add mScarletH:ORF65.KSHV to the cultured GFP‑LC3B U2OS cells at a multiplicity of infection of 10 and incubate for 30 min.

steps.title: Allocate sample‑prep time
steps.instruction: Complete the FIB‑SEM sample preparation within 2–3 days; microwave‑assisted steps (4–18) require about 6–7 h total.

steps.title: Prepare fixation and staining solutions
steps.instruction: Make all solutions required for steps 5–13 (2.5 % glutaraldehyde + 2 % formaldehyde, 2 % reduced OsO₄, 1 % thiocarbohydrazide, 2 % OsO₄, 1 % uranyl acetate, ethanol series, epoxy resin, etc.) in the order listed; prepare ~1.5–2 mL of each per culture dish; some solutions must be freshly prepared immediately before use.

steps.title: Post‑fix with glutaraldehyde/formaldehyde
steps.instruction: Replace the culture medium with fresh 2.5 % glutaraldehyde + 2 % formaldehyde in 0.15 M Na‑cacodylate buffer containing 2 mM CaCl₂; place the lid‑less dish in the PELCO EM Pro vacuum chamber; run the microwave on/off cycles of steps 1–4 (low‑wattage); add ice to the chamber and run high‑wattage cycles (650 W) for steps 5–7 as described in Table S1.

steps.title: Rinse in cacodylate buffer
steps.instruction: Rinse the cells three times with 0.15 M Na‑cacodylate buffer + 2 mM CaCl₂ using microwave steps 8–10 (vacuum chamber).

steps.title: Post‑fix with reduced osmium
steps.instruction: Exchange buffer for 2 % reduced osmium tetroxide; treat samples with microwave on/off cycles under vacuum according to steps 11–15 of Table S1.

steps.title: Rinse in distilled water
steps.instruction: Rinse the cells three times in double‑distilled H₂O using microwave steps 16–18; ensure thorough removal of residual OsO₄.

steps.title: Incubate in thiocarbohydrazide
steps.instruction: Load 1 % thiocarbohydrazide solution into a syringe fitted with a 0.22 µm filter; discard the H₂O from the dish, add the filtered thiocarbohydrazide, and incubate with microwave on/off cycles under vacuum (steps 19–23).

steps.title: Rinse thoroughly after TCH
steps.instruction: Rinse with H₂O in the fume hood until the solution is clear; then wash three times with H₂O in the microwave (steps 24–26); tilt the dish and gently flow H₂O to remove any surface film.

steps.title: Incubate with fresh OsO₄
steps.instruction: Treat cells with 2 % osmium tetroxide using microwave on/off cycles under vacuum (steps 27–31).

steps.title: Rinse after OsO₄
steps.instruction: Rinse the cells three times in H₂O (microwave steps 32–34).

steps.title: Stain with uranyl acetate
steps.instruction: Incubate cells in 1 % uranyl acetate using microwave on/off cycles under vacuum (steps 35–39).

steps.title: Final water rinses and waste disposal
steps.instruction: Rinse three times in H₂O (steps 40–42); collect all liquid waste from uranyl acetate washes and discard together with the uranyl acetate solution; samples may be stored in uranyl acetate at 4 °C for up to 1 day, but should be processed promptly.

steps.title: Dehydrate through ethanol series
steps.instruction: Prepare 25, 50, 70, and 90 % ethanol in H₂O; incubate the dish on ice in each solution using microwave on/off cycles under vacuum (steps 43–54); then incubate three times in 100 % dry ethanol on ice with microwave cycles (steps 55–63). Use only polyethylene culture dishes.

steps.title: Prepare epoxy embedding resin
steps.instruction: Mix epoxy resin components as described in the Materials section; the resin can be prepared during steps 13–15.

steps.title: Infiltrate with graded epoxy resin
steps.instruction: Prepare 25, 50, and 75 % epoxy resin diluted with dry ethanol; exchange the ethanol for 25 % epoxy and process in the microwave vacuum chamber (step 64); aspirate and replace with fresh 25 % epoxy, microwave (step 65); repeat the exchange twice with 50 % epoxy and twice with 75 % epoxy (steps 66–69); tilt the dish to let resin drain and pipette off excess.

steps.title: Infiltrate with 100 % epoxy resin
steps.instruction: Pipette off the 75 % epoxy mixture and add 100 % epoxy resin; place the dish on a laboratory shaker or rocker in the fume hood for gentle agitation; incubate 1 h, replace resin, drain, incubate another 1 h; repeat 3–4 times with fresh resin; for the final exchange fill only the indentation formed by the plastic dish’s hole; wipe the rim with a swab to remove excess resin; optionally warm resin to 50–60 °C briefly to lower viscosity, avoiding prolonged heating; ensure no bubbles and remove any adhering bubbles with an eyelash‑mounted toothpick or vacuum.

steps.title: Polymerize resin
steps.instruction: Place the resin‑embedded sample in an oven at 60 °C and polymerize for 48 h.
